role: Amendment 2 to the Stage 2 plan. Relaxes the stop clause of section 5.3 so that the pre-declared second-stage interaction model is fitted, with the failed marker-specificity and ambiguity gates (G4, G5) reported as per-type annotation caveats. Changes no scientific parameter.
sha256_algorithm: SHA-256 over the raw bytes of stage2_plan.amendment_2.md; verify with Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256

amends.clause_superseded: section 5.3, condition 1 (per-type G1/G3/G4/G5 gates as a study-level stop)
amends.clause_retained: section 5.3, conditions 2 and 3 (>=6 of 9 evaluable; CD8_T, NK and Microglia each individually evaluable)

locked_before: Any Stage 2 interaction estimate, permutation p-value, power figure or equivalence classification had been computed or viewed. Stage 1 estimates and the Stage 2 annotation QC gate outcome were already known and this is disclosed in section 2 of the amendment.
authorising_decision: User, 2026-10-21, J1 fork in JNOplan_implementation_status.md section 9 - option J1-A 'Amend to v1.2 and estimate'.

stage1_reference.note: Stage 1 pre-specification is unchanged by this plan and by the Stage 2 analysis.

deviation_policy: Any further change requires a dated, hashed amendment written before the affected computation. Outcome-driven retuning after a Stage 2 estimate has been viewed is prohibited.
